## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.

Never run Bandit on `ledgerly` without invoking it through `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh` so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

When reporting test output, paste the exact output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Optimize invoice-summary reporting; Tenacity refactor is superseded and stopped until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`billing_v3` active; `billing_v1` is frozen and superseded—never seed or write it. Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, `2025-03`, version `3`; funding `operating-usd`; batch `batch-20250328-1842`. Host: tenant/account 73.

## Ruled-out approaches
Hand-rolled retries; platform-default CSV encoding; six-hour Celery `visibility_timeout`; repeated per-currency invoice queries and individual conversions.

## Plan and progress
Done: aggregate invoices once per account, batch conversions, add 37-query regression, Ruff, diff checks, and tests. Payment step done. Refund fix not started; status unknown. No pending command.

## Recent work
`pytest -q tests/reports`: `63 passed, 2 skipped`; largest duration `3.18 seconds`. Tenant 73 runtime fell from 38.6s to 4.27s; queries fell from 2,417 to 37 with 14,802 aggregates preserved.
